title: You Are My Portion: The Path of Life
summary: David asks God to keep him and confesses that he has no good apart from the LORD. He delights in God's people, refuses the worship of other gods, and rejoices that the LORD is his portion and his inheritance. Because God is always before him and at his right hand, he is unshaken, and he trusts that God will not abandon him to Sheol but will show him the path of life and fill him with joy in his presence.

from.where: The Study Bible's notes on Psalm 16
from.text: Psalm 16 is a psalm of trust and confession

line: David confesses he has no good apart from the LORD, his portion and inheritance, and trusts God to show him the path of life rather than abandon him to the grave.
guide: Ask what you count on to make life good, then pray verse 5 as your own; some days you will mean it fully, and some days it will be a prayer to come to mean it. Practise verse 8 as a daily habit. If you are grieving someone who trusted Christ, verse 11 is a verse to hold.

stanzas.title: Heading and confession: no good apart from you
Delight in the saints, refusal of other gods
The LORD is my portion and inheritance
Counsel by night, the LORD at my right hand
Not abandoned to Sheol: the path of life

verses.t: A Miktam of David. Preserve me, O God, for in You I take refuge.
I said to the LORD, “You are my Lord; apart from You I have no good thing.”
As for the saints in the land, they are the excellence in whom all my delight resides.
Sorrows will multiply to those who chase other gods. I will not pour out their libations of blood, or speak their names with my lips.
The LORD is my chosen portion and my cup; You have made my lot secure.
The lines of my boundary have fallen in pleasant places; surely my inheritance is delightful.
I will bless the LORD who counsels me; even at night my conscience instructs me.
I have set the LORD always before me. Because He is at my right hand, I will not be shaken.
Therefore my heart is glad and my tongue rejoices; my body also will dwell securely.
For You will not abandon my soul to Sheol, nor will You let Your Holy One see decay.
You have made known to me the path of life; You will fill me with joy in Your presence, with eternal pleasures at Your right hand.
